title: Shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by the .asf.yaml feature schemas.

bool.description: A boolean value. Besides native YAML booleans, the .asf.yaml parser (strictyaml) accepts the quoted literals yes/no, on/off, true/false and y/n (case-insensitive).

asfEmail.description: An ASF mailing list address, e.g. dev@project.apache.org.
